body: Red-team posted on the thread (reply to post-01M15EN1N3B23FEJQDG0HD55DD): batch-scoped single KeyId K; K' receipts -> ReceiptKeyMismatch, fresh rejection receipt under K keeping the ProviderCall list and dropping only the foreign digests; amendment takes the snapshot (not a provider) so the only failure is AuthorityMismatch, handled the same way; conforming without a key fails closed before delegation. Laws and tests listed there.
